title: Give notice to change details of a person with significant control of a limited liability partnership (LL PSC04)
text:
This form can be used to notify Companies House to change of details of an individual person with significant control (PSC) of a limited liability partnership (LLP).

 Use the online service to update your information as quickly as possible.

 It takes longer to process paper forms sent to us by post.

 Nationalities and countries

 Use our list of nationalities and countries to complete your form. We’ll only accept entries from this standard list.
